reason: A DSH web plugin that automates GitHub issue and pull request handling by polling repositories, running agents on local checkouts, and optionally pushing changes, posting reviews, and merging pull requests.

summaries.zh: 通过轮询 GitHub issue 和 PR，在本地代码库中运行智能体并提供审核队列，以自动化修复、实现、评审及相关 GitHub 操作。
summaries.en: Automates GitHub issue and pull request workflows by running agents on local checkouts through a review queue and optionally pushing changes, posting reviews, or merging pull requests.

capabilities: Polls GitHub repositories for issues and pull requests
Runs agents against locally checked-out repositories
Creates branches, commits changes, and pushes to GitHub
Posts issue comments and pull request reviews
Can open and auto-merge pull requests according to configuration
Provides a web-based review and execution queue
